# Aurora Eyes

> Sacred, modern divination — tarot, runes, angel cards, and horary astrology readings with grounded, poetic interpretations.

Aurora Eyes is a free divination platform offering instant tarot, rune, angel card, and horary astrology readings. Free readings run on a local interpretation engine; an optional premium tier unlocks AI-powered chat and deeper interpretations. The voice and aesthetic are calm and reflective — a "trusted friend," not a fortune teller.

## Readings

- [Free Tarot Reading](/free-tarot-reading): Multi-card tarot spreads with full interpretations.
- [Yes/No Tarot Reading](/yes-no-tarot-reading): Single-card binary answers for quick decisions.
- [Pick a Card Reading](/pick-a-card-reading): Intuitive pick-a-card guidance.
- [Rune Reading](/rune-reading): Elder Futhark rune casts.
- [Angel Card Reading](/angel-card-reading): Gentle angelic guidance.
- [Horary Astrology Reading](/horary-reading): Question-based astrological chart readings.
- [Daily Tarot Reading](/daily-tarot-reading): Today's collective tarot reading.
